extracted.name: Homemade Dry Onion Soup Mix
extracted.description: Make your own Homemade Dry Onion Soup Mix with pantry spices you already have. It’s perfect for seasoning meats, soups, dips, and more - without any added preservatives.
ingredient_lines: 2 Tablespoons beef bouillon granules ((30g), or bullion paste, or 6 beef bullion cubes, chopped)
instruction_lines: Mix all ingredients together. Store in an airtight container. Use in recipes that call for one envelope of dry onion soup mix.
To make as a dip, mix recipe with one pint of sour cream.
